Read the field notes. If available, consult case notes or medical records, and talk with the injured person.
3. If inconsistencies between reports exist, note them.
4. Clarify sequence of events by interviewing co-workers, witnesses, and supervisors.
5. Obtain and examine the evidence.
6. Conduct a site inspection. Note working conditions, safety practices/violations, similar incidents, and equipment/job inspection records.
